texto.es: Nos cuentas qué le pasa a tu auto y te decimos cuándo puedes traerlo al taller en Miramar.
texto.en: Tell us what is going on with your car and we will let you know when to bring it by our Miramar shop.

texto.es: Alex revisa tu auto a fondo antes de hablar de precio, para saber exactamente qué necesita.
texto.en: Alex checks your car thoroughly before talking price, so we know exactly what it needs.

texto.es: Te explicamos las opciones y te damos un precio claro antes de tocar el auto, sin sorpresas.
texto.en: We walk you through your options and give you a clear price before we touch the car, no surprises.

texto.es: Hacemos el trabajo con el mismo cuidado que ves en nuestras fotos y te devolvemos el auto listo.
texto.en: We do the work with the same care you see in our photos and hand your car back ready to go.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza después de revisar tu auto en persona. Llámanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every job is quoted after we take a look at your vehicle in person. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Mantenimiento y reparación general para que tu auto siga rodando, el trabajo de siempre del taller.
texto.en: General maintenance and repair to keep your car running, the everyday work our shop is built on.

texto.es: Alex revisa el problema a fondo antes de recomendar cualquier reparación, sin inventar trabajo de más.
texto.en: Alex checks the problem thoroughly before recommending any repair, no padding the job with extra work.

texto.es: Cambio de frenos y revisión de suspensión, explicando qué piezas se usan y por qué.
texto.en: Brake jobs and suspension checks, with Alex telling you which parts are being used and why.

texto.es: Diagnóstico y soluciones de transmisión, incluso cuando el problema aparece en medio de un viaje.
texto.en: Transmission diagnostics and fixes, even when the problem shows up in the middle of a road trip.

pie.es: ¿No ves exactamente lo que necesitas? Llámanos igual: la mayoría de nuestros trabajos empiezan como una consulta puntual.
pie.en: Do not see exactly what you need? Call us anyway: most of our jobs start out as a quick question.

items.quote: Alex is beyond amazing! My car broke down in the middle of the everglades and the first shop I took it to was trying to charge me left and right for unnecessary repairs and said they couldn't fix the car for at least another 5 days.

My family has been coming to Alex for years. He is a very talented mechanic. His prices are fair and he is honest. He is the only mechanic we use. Highly recommend for peace of mind when seeking a mechanic.
Alex was awesome in every aspect! He did my brakes in an extremely timely manner, the price was great, and best of all he was extremely honest about what was needed and which parts were being used.
